name: Playback Info Card
description: Real-time, Tautulli-inspired visual monitoring grid injected directly into the Jellyfin Admin Dashboard.
overview: Transient live monitoring displaying real-time session telemetry, direct play vs transcode status, transcode reasons, stream bandwidth, and ETA.
